parameters.query: with cand as (select g.id, g.email, coalesce(g.cat_name, 'A cat') as name, count(l.*)::int as likes, g.gallery_approved_at from ttw.generations g join ttw.gallery_likes l on l.generation_id = g.id and l.created_at >= now() - interval '7 days' where g.gallery_status = 'approved' and not exists (select 1 from ttw.cat_of_week c where c.generation_id = g.id) group by g.id, g.email, g.cat_name, g.gallery_approved_at order by count(l.*) desc, g.gallery_approved_at asc, g.id asc limit 1), w as (insert into ttw.cat_of_week (week_start, generation_id, likes) select (now() at time zone 'Europe/Berlin')::date, id, likes from cand on conflict (week_start) do nothing returning generation_id, week_start, likes), b as (insert into ttw.bonus_credits (email, reason, source_id) select c.email, 'cat_of_week', c.id from cand c where exists (select 1 from w) returning id) select c.id, c.email, c.name, w.likes, to_char(w.week_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as week_start, (select count(*) from b)::int as credits from cand c join w on w.generation_id = c.id
